pkgmetadata.longdescription: QQ_Term is a Qt6 terminal emulator built for the QindaQt desktop. Each window is one independent shell session (the desktop's window containers provide tab and split grouping), with named profiles, 42 built-in color schemes with dark/light tone hints, per-window transparency with optional KWin blur-behind, theme rotation so new windows never repeat a look, and per-window global menu export over the desktop's D-Bus dbusmenu stack. Configuration lives in ~/.config/qqterm/qqterm.ini.
